headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 24, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 9-7 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Logan VanWey earning the win. Joey Loperfido led the Astros' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Seattle Mariners edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, thanks to a strong performance from George Kirby and a crucial home run from Cole Young. The Kansas City Royals dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-5 victory. Jac Caglianone led the Royals' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Jaden Hill, a right-handed pitcher for the Colorado Rockies, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder tendonitis. The Rockies' Blas Castaño has also been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 18, 2026, with a right pectoral strain. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Chicago Cubs' Ben Brown and Edward Cabrera, the Kansas City Royals' Maikel Garcia, the Detroit Tigers' Burch Smith, the Miami Marlins' Josh Ekness and Liam Hicks.

The St. Louis Cardinals made a trade on June 23, 2026, sending RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for a player to be named later. The Houston Astros acquired SS Marcus Brown from the Washington Nationals for cash. The Astros also traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Blue Jays 9-7**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a 9-7 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Logan VanWey earning the win. Joey Loperfido led the Astros' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Pirates in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, thanks to a strong performance from George Kirby and a crucial home run from Cole Young. Young's seventh homer of the season came on a fly ball to right field, scoring Luke Raley and helping seal the win.

top_news.title: **Royals Rout Rays 12-5**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-5 victory. Jac Caglianone led the Royals' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-6 victory over the Texas Rangers in a closely contested game. Owen Caissie led the Rangers' offense with a home run and three RBIs, while Sandy Alcantara pitched 6.2 innings for the Marlins, allowing one earned run.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Jaden Hill Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-handed pitcher Jaden Hill has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder tendonitis, effective retroactive to June 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Acquire Player in Trade**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals made a trade on June 23, 2026, sending RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for a player to be named later.
